sources.sentence: Without clear leadership, the plan could fall apart at the seams.

brief.meaningEn: Begin to fail or come apart in many connected parts.
brief.meaningZh: 多個相關部分開始失效或瓦解。
brief.grammar: a plan/organisation is falling apart at the seams; past fell apart at the seams.
brief.register: Informal vivid metaphor; stronger than one minor setback.
brief.boundaryZh: 指廣泛失序，不宜因一個已修正的小錯便說全面瓦解；本課不是衣物縫線真的鬆開。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把強烈比喻當成所有小麻煩的通用描述。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用多處問題支持整體失序的判斷，並指出優先補救。

listening.promptZh: 這句形容甚麼程度的問題？

options.en: Several connected parts of the plan were failing.
options.zh: 計劃多個相關部分正在失效。

options.en: One small spelling mistake had already been corrected.
options.zh: 一個小串字錯誤已被修正。

options.en: Every arrangement was running smoothly.
options.zh: 每項安排都運作順暢。

options.en: Only the decoration needed a minor colour change.
options.zh: 只有裝飾需要稍微改色。

listening.explanationZh: 物資、時間表及統籌同時出問題，支持強烈的整體瓦解比喻。
listening.en: With missing supplies, conflicting schedules and no coordinator, the event plan was falling apart at the seams.
listening.zh: 物資短缺、時間表互相衝突，又沒有統籌員，活動計劃正多處失控瓦解。

reply.promptEn: Why are you asking for urgent help with the project?
reply.promptZh: 你為甚麼要求有人緊急協助項目？

options.en: It is falling apart at the seams, with delays and confused responsibilities across the team.
options.zh: 它正多處失控，團隊各處都有延誤和職責混亂。

options.en: Several essential tasks are unassigned.
options.zh: 幾項必要工作仍未有人負責。

options.en: The schedule and delivery plan no longer match.
options.zh: 時間表與送貨計劃已不再配合。

options.en: We need someone to coordinate the remaining work.
options.zh: 我們需要有人統籌剩下的工作。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都可說明求援原因；金句概括多處失序，並提供具體問題作依據。

scene.promptZh: 一個社團同時出現帳目無人管、活動撞期和重要訊息無人回覆。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The organisation is falling apart at the seams.
options.zh: 這個組織正多處失序瓦解。

options.en: The organisation has only one small issue that has already been resolved.
options.zh: 這個組織只有一個已解決的小問題。

options.en: The organisation’s processes are working smoothly throughout.
options.zh: 這個組織各方面程序都運作順暢。

scene.explanationZh: 多個重要系統出問題，不是單一已解決小事或整體順暢。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合用 falling apart at the seams？

options.en: Several key systems fail and nobody knows who is responsible.
options.zh: 多個關鍵系統失效，沒有人知道誰負責。

options.en: One label is misspelt, corrected immediately, and all essential work continues smoothly.
options.zh: 一個標籤串錯字後立即修正，所有必要工作仍順暢。

options.en: Repeated handover failures cause problems throughout a project.
options.zh: 反覆交接失敗，在整個項目各處造成問題。

contrast.explanationZh: 一個立即修正的小錯沒有支持如此強烈、廣泛的瓦解意思。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「計劃到處出問題，我不知先做甚麼。」哪句回應最有用？

options.en: It sounds as if things are falling apart at the seams. Let us list the essential tasks and agree on one coordinator first.
options.zh: 聽來事情正多處失控。我們先列必要工作，並議定一名統籌員吧。

options.en: Deal with one late email first and postpone checking which essential tasks have no owner.
options.zh: 先處理一封遲覆電郵，押後查哪些必要工作沒人負責。

options.en: Fix the visible delay, but leave responsibility for the remaining failures unassigned.
options.zh: 修正看得到的延誤，但其餘出問題的工作仍不分配責任。

dialogue.explanationZh: 多處失序需要先列必要任務及統籌；只追一封電郵或修一個延誤，卻不處理責任分配，未能穩定整體。

speaking.en: Without clear responsibilities, the plan could fall apart at the seams.
speaking.zh: 如果職責不清，計劃可能多處失控瓦解。
speaking.promptZh: 你想提醒組員盡早釐清職責，避免廣泛失序。先聽，再自己說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：校慶活動同時有物資未到、節目時間撞期、負責人聯絡不上等問題。用一至兩句英文描述整體情況並提出先找統籌及列急事。

examples.en: The celebration is falling apart at the seams: supplies are missing and the schedule clashes. We need a coordinator and a list of urgent tasks.
examples.zh: 校慶活動正多處失控：物資未到，時間表又撞期。我們需要統籌員和一份急事清單。

examples.en: With no one coordinating and several arrangements failing, the plan could fall apart at the seams. Let us identify the urgent problems and assign clear roles.
examples.zh: 沒有人統籌，幾項安排又失效，計劃可能多處瓦解。我們找出緊急問題，並清楚分工吧。

writing.selfCheckZh: 需要多項重要問題支持強烈比喻，並提出實際優先處理方法；不是單一小錯就全面否定。

takeaways.en: The plan fell apart at the seams when several key arrangements failed.
takeaways.zh: 幾項關鍵安排失效時，計劃多處瓦解。

takeaways.en: A lack of coordination can leave a project falling apart at the seams.
takeaways.zh: 缺乏協調可能令項目多處失控瓦解。

brief.meaningEn: Demonstrate that an opinion or claim is right, sometimes with more focus on being right than on solving a problem.
brief.meaningZh: 顯示某個看法或主張正確；有時過分重視證明自己對，而忽略解決問題。
brief.grammar: prove a point; proving a point; focus on proving a point rather than + gerund.
brief.register: Neutral expression with a potentially critical tone depending on context.
brief.boundaryZh: 可以是有用示範，也可以是爭勝；不代表每次證明觀點都自私。
brief.misconceptionZh: 要從語境分辨展示證據和一味爭對錯，不要自動批評。
brief.outcomeZh: 能看出談話在尋找解決方法，還是在執着證明自己正確。

options.en: Being right mattered more to him than a useful fix.
options.zh: 對他來說，自己正確比有效解決更重要。

options.en: He was quietly correcting the error without seeking any recognition.
options.zh: 他正默默修正錯誤，不求任何肯定。

options.en: He had agreed to stop discussing the earlier mistake.
options.zh: 他已同意停止討論先前錯誤。

options.en: The group had no problem left to solve.
options.zh: 小組已沒有問題要解決。

listening.explanationZh: just 和 instead of 指明批評在於爭對錯壓過修正，不是說所有展示證據都不好。
listening.en: He kept bringing up the old mistake just to prove a point, instead of helping us fix it.
listening.zh: 他不斷重提舊錯，只為證明自己的看法，沒有幫助我們修正。

reply.promptEn: Why did you show us the two versions of the instructions?
reply.promptZh: 你為甚麼給我們看兩個版本的指引？

options.en: I wanted to prove a point: shorter steps were easier to follow in our test.
options.zh: 我想證明一個觀點：在我們的測試中，較短步驟較容易跟隨。

options.en: I wanted everyone to compare the wording for themselves.
options.zh: 我想讓大家自行比較措辭。

options.en: The examples made the difference easier to explain.
options.zh: 這些例子讓差別較容易解釋。

options.en: I thought a direct comparison would help our discussion.
options.zh: 我認為直接比較有助討論。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都能合理說明示範目的；金句是用具體測試展示主張，並非必然爭吵。

scene.promptZh: 同事只反覆說自己早就警告過，拒絕討論現在的補救。哪句最貼切？

options.en: He seems more interested in proving a point than finding a solution.
options.zh: 他似乎較想證明自己正確，而不是找解決方法。

options.en: He has already helped the team agree on a repair plan.
options.zh: 他已幫助團隊議定修補方案。

options.en: He is avoiding any mention of his earlier opinion.
options.zh: 他在避免提及自己先前的看法。

scene.explanationZh: 反覆強調早有警告而拒絕補救，顯示重點在證明自己對。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個說法不宜當成 prove a point 的必然意思？

options.en: A speaker tries to demonstrate a claim.
options.zh: 說話者嘗試展示一項主張。

options.en: Examples may be used to show why an opinion is right.
options.zh: 可以用例子顯示某個看法為甚麼正確。

options.en: The speaker must always be selfish and uninterested in helping.
options.zh: 說話者必定總是自私，而且不想幫忙。

contrast.explanationZh: prove a point 可以中性地表示用示範支持觀點；是否只顧爭勝要看語境。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我很想讓大家知道我當初是對的，但現在要先救活動。」哪句接話最有建設性？

options.en: You can make your concerns clear without focusing on proving a point. Let us solve the urgent problem first.
options.zh: 你可以說清疑慮，而不用只顧證明自己正確。我們先解決急事吧。

options.en: Keep repeating the warning until everyone admits you were right, even if the activity fails.
options.zh: 即使活動失敗，也要繼續重複警告，直到大家承認你對。

options.en: Any evidence supporting your concern must be left out forever.
options.zh: 任何支持你疑慮的證據都必須永遠不提。

dialogue.explanationZh: 把眼前解決問題優先，同時不要求永遠壓下合理疑慮。

speaking.en: I care more about finding a solution than proving a point.
speaking.zh: 我較重視找解決方法，而不是證明自己正確。
speaking.promptZh: 你想把討論從爭對錯帶回解決問題。先聽，再自己說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：小組選錯場地，你曾提醒過，但現在需要另找地方。用一至兩句英文表示你不想只顧證明自己對，而想先補救。

examples.en: I do not want to spend our time proving a point about the venue. Let us find another place before the event.
examples.zh: 我不想把時間花在證明自己對場地的看法正確。活動前，我們先找另一個地方吧。

examples.en: Finding a new venue matters more than proving a point now. We can review the earlier decision after the urgent work is done.
examples.zh: 現在找新場地比證明自己正確更重要。急事處理好後，我們再檢討先前決定。

writing.selfCheckZh: 提出具體補救，並把檢討放到合適時間；不是說所有證據或原來疑慮都沒有價值。

takeaways.en: Let us solve the problem instead of just proving a point.
takeaways.zh: 我們解決問題吧，不要只顧證明自己正確。

takeaways.en: She used a simple demonstration to prove a point about clear instructions.
takeaways.zh: 她用簡單示範，證明有關清楚指引的觀點。

brief.meaningEn: A difficult effort that requires sustained work against obstacles; uphill battle and uphill climb are related images.
brief.meaningZh: 需要持續努力克服障礙的艱難過程；uphill battle 與 uphill climb 是相關比喻。
brief.grammar: Be/face an uphill battle; be/feel like an uphill climb (optionally an endless uphill climb). Keep the article an before uphill.
brief.register: Common figurative language; a community organiser explains a demanding project to volunteers.
brief.boundaryZh: 兩種比喻都可指長期困難，不保證成功或失敗，也不可把 climb 說成一定已有進展。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是實際爬坡或打仗；單一小麻煩不足以支持這種強烈說法。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出持續障礙，選用合適的艱難過程比喻並提出起步做法。

options.en: The approval process will require sustained effort against obstacles.
options.zh: 審批過程需要持續努力克服障礙。

options.en: Approval has already been refused permanently.
options.zh: 批准已被永久拒絕。

options.en: The process will be straightforward with no resistance.
options.zh: 過程會直接順利，沒有阻力。

options.en: Funding and local support are already fully secured.
options.zh: 資金和本地支持已完全確定。

listening.explanationZh: 資金和反對是具體障礙，支持艱難過程；將會很難不等於已永久失敗。
listening.en: With little funding and strong local opposition, getting the new playground approved will be an uphill battle.
listening.zh: 資金少，又有強烈本地反對，要讓新遊樂場獲批將會很艱難。

reply.promptEn: How do you feel about restoring the old community hall?
reply.promptZh: 你怎樣看修復舊社區會堂這件事？

options.en: It may be an uphill battle, but I think the first step is to get a proper survey.
options.zh: 這可能很艱難，但我認為第一步是做正式勘察。

options.en: We need to understand the costs before committing.
options.zh: 承諾之前，我們需要了解費用。

options.en: I would like to hear what local residents need.
options.zh: 我想聽聽本地居民需要甚麼。

options.en: It is worth exploring, provided we check the building’s condition.
options.zh: 只要我們先查看樓宇狀況，這件事值得研究。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都自然表達看法；金句承認可能困難，並提出具體起點而非保證成功。

scene.promptZh: 你想令學校採用新節能設備，但預算緊、程序多，需要多次解釋。哪句合適？

options.en: Winning support could be an uphill climb.
options.zh: 爭取支持可能是艱難而漫長的過程。

options.en: Support has already been secured without any work.
options.zh: 不用做任何工作，支持已確定。

options.en: One routine email is the only step and there are no obstacles.
options.zh: 只需一封例行電郵，完全沒有障礙。

scene.explanationZh: 預算、程序和多次解釋顯示要持續努力；could 不預先斷言成敗。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不像 an uphill battle？

options.en: A proposal faces repeated objections and limited resources.
options.zh: 建議反覆遇到反對，資源也有限。

options.en: An application requires months of work to overcome major barriers.
options.zh: 申請需要數月工作以克服重大障礙。

options.en: A routine request is accepted immediately with no difficulty.
options.zh: 例行要求立即獲接納，沒有困難。

contrast.explanationZh: 沒有困難而立即完成，欠缺艱難持續努力的意思。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「這個社區項目阻力很多，是不是不用試了？」哪句回應最準確？

options.en: It may be an uphill battle, but that does not decide the outcome. Let us identify the main obstacles and a sensible first step.
options.zh: 這可能需要苦戰，但不代表結果已定。我們找出主要障礙及合理第一步吧。

options.en: Calling it difficult proves it has already failed.
options.zh: 說它困難就證明它已經失敗。

options.en: If you keep trying, success is guaranteed regardless of resources.
options.zh: 只要繼續嘗試，無論資源如何都保證成功。

dialogue.explanationZh: 承認困難而不把它當成已失敗或必勝，並提出查障礙和第一步。

speaking.en: Changing the policy may be an uphill climb, so we need a clear plan.
speaking.zh: 改變政策可能是艱難而漫長的過程，因此我們需要清晰計劃。
speaking.promptZh: 你想提醒小組改變不容易，需要準備；先聽示範，再自己說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你們想在社區設單車停泊位，但空間少，有居民反對。用一至兩句英文承認困難，並提出先收集需要及找可行位置。

examples.en: Getting bike parking may be an uphill battle because space is limited and some residents object. We should collect people’s needs and look for suitable sites.
examples.zh: 爭取單車停泊位可能需要苦戰，因為空間有限，也有居民反對。我們應收集大家的需要，並找合適位置。

examples.en: This could be an uphill climb because space is scarce and some residents object, but we can start by collecting local needs and checking possible bike-parking sites.
examples.zh: 空間不足且部分居民反對，設單車停泊位可能是艱難而漫長的過程；但我們可先收集居民需要，並查看可行的停泊位置。

writing.selfCheckZh: 兩個示範都應寫出空間少、部分居民反對，以及先收集需要和尋找可行位置；不可保證結果。

takeaways.en: Securing support can be an uphill battle.
takeaways.zh: 爭取支持可能需要苦戰。

takeaways.en: It was an uphill climb, but we kept working on the main obstacles.
takeaways.zh: 這是一段艱難而漫長的過程，但我們持續處理主要障礙。
